notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are special revenue funds in the governmental total), so business_type and proprietary are null. Receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column of p5. 'Taxes' split using Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): property 3,572,636, PPD sales tax 3,199, motor vehicle 292,329, penalties/interest 5,192 (sums to 3,873,356). Other Local Receipts, Intermediate Sources and Non-Revenue Receipts split using fund schedules (computed amounts noted). Non-Program Receipts 48,945 (mostly Employee Benefit Fund 'Other Non-Revenue Receipts' 48,699) left as other with review. Transfers: p5 General column 246,900 in (49,900 from Bond Fund + 197,000 to Depreciation) and other funds (49,900) out; net 197,000 matches Statement of Activities; the 197,000 has no matching outflow in the General Fund (decision_needed). Transfers are excluded from receipts/disbursements on p5; in detail they are 'other financing' lines, with printed fund totals on p9, p11 and p15 including them. Statement of Net Position (p1) has no liabilities, so total_liabilities is null. Detail: individual fund budget-and-actual schedules (pp8-18) recorded; GF components (p6) and Other Governmental Funds combining (p7) not repeated to avoid double counting; County Treasurer schedule (p19) is a pass-through reconciliation of the General Fund and is not recorded. No School 'Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses' exhibit is in the trimmed PDF, so General Fund spending is by program only (not itemized). Small $1-$2 rounding differences in the printed totals are in report_discrepancies. Statement of Activities p2 shows Activities 407,448 and Capital Outlay 1,124,370, versus p5 452,448 and 1,079,370 (45,000 QCPU spending classified differently); p5 used. Read pages 1-19 of 19
